$comment: Operations in THIS repo needing more than routine autonomy. Absence of a match means routine: no prompt. Seeded empty on purpose -- add entries only for operations this project genuinely gates.

tiers.routine: Agent performs autonomously, no prompt. Default for everything unlisted, including advancing main, PRs and releases.
tiers.operator-approved: Owner approves first; the agent then performs it.
tiers.operator-actioned: A human performs it. Reserved for destructive mutation of live shared infrastructure.
